lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.form.future: It can't be in the future
lifecycle.empty.noMatchBody: Try other filters or clear them.
lifecycle.kindHint.verbal_warning: A first, spoken word about it
lifecycle.kindHint.written_warning: On record: the employee confirms it in the app
lifecycle.kindHint.reprimand: An official sanction, kept on file
lifecycle.fineStatus.approved: approved, comes off the next payslip
lifecycle.nextStep.written_warning: If it happens again, the next step is a written warning.
lifecycle.nextStep.final_warning: If it happens again, the next step is a final warning.
lifecycle.nextStep.consider_termination: A final warning is in force: another breach can end the employment.
lifecycle.discipline.description: Warnings and reprimands, the fines proposed with them, and what the employee says.
lifecycle.discipline.emptyBody: When something goes wrong, record it here: the employee reads it in the app and can explain.
lifecycle.record.newHint: The employee reads it in the app, confirms it and can write an explanation.
lifecycle.record.descriptionHint: Facts only: what, where and when. The employee reads this.
lifecycle.record.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: insulin left out of the fridge from 14:00 to 17:30 on Saturday.
lifecycle.record.evidenceHint: A photo of the thermometer log, the receipt, a screenshot
lifecycle.record.proposeFineHint: It goes to Payroll as a proposal; it comes off the payslip only once approved there.
lifecycle.record.fineNote: The employee sees the proposed fine and can dispute it.
lifecycle.record.fineHidden: The amount is for people who see salaries.
lifecycle.record.noExplanation: No explanation yet. The employee can write one in the app.
lifecycle.record.expiresHint: Afterwards it no longer counts for the next step
lifecycle.record.withdrawBody: It stops counting for {name}. A proposed fine is cancelled in Payroll.
lifecycle.suspensions.description: Who is suspended, until when and why. Their record stays; the bot and the app leave them alone.
lifecycle.suspensions.daysLeft: {n} days left | {n} day left | {n} days left
lifecycle.suspensions.emptyNowBody: Everyone who works here has their access.
lifecycle.suspend.title: Suspend someone
lifecycle.suspend.description: Pause their access for a while. Their data, task history and pay setup stay.
lifecycle.suspend.lastDayHint: Access comes back by itself the day after
lifecycle.suspend.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the cash shortage is being checked
lifecycle.suspend.effects: Meanwhile they get no routine tasks, reminders or announcements; the bot only says their access is paused.
lifecycle.reinstate.title: Reinstate {name}?
lifecycle.reinstate.body: Access comes back now, with the same role and branches.
lifecycle.person.suspendHint: Pause their access for a while
lifecycle.person.counting: {n} records count from the last 6 months | {n} record counts from the last 6 months | {n} records count from the last 6 months
lifecycle.person.notSuspended: Not suspended: their access is open.
lifecycle.soon.title: In the making
lifecycle.soon.org.line: Departments, their heads and who reports to whom, as one tree.
lifecycle.soon.org.body: See the whole company at a glance, with open vacancies as dashed places; drag a person to propose a move.
lifecycle.soon.terminations.line: Resignations and dismissals with notice, final pay and the exit interview.
lifecycle.soon.terminations.body: An employee asks to leave in the app, you agree on the last day, and on that evening the final payslip and the handover are ready.
lifecycle.soon.terminations.meanwhile: Meanwhile: offboard from the person's page
lifecycle.soon.changes.line: Transfers, promotions and pay changes that apply on their day once approved.
lifecycle.soon.changes.body: Propose a new position, branch or pay from a date; after approval it applies by itself and shows in the person's history.
lifecycle.soon.changes.meanwhile: Meanwhile: change it on the person's page
lifecycle.soon.equipment.line: Uniforms, keys and devices: who has what, and what comes back when they leave.
lifecycle.soon.equipment.body: Issue an item with a photo, the employee confirms it in the app, and leaving asks for it back.
lifecycle.soon.reviews.line: Review rounds with self and manager answers, goals and the outcome.
lifecycle.soon.reviews.body: Open a round, everyone answers a few questions about their work, the manager adds theirs, and a raise or a bonus follows from it.
